components.description: University-provided standard parental leave of 18 weeks for tenured and tenure-track nine-month faculty to care for a child within 12 months of birth, adoption or foster placement; accrued sick leave is used first, then the leave continues at half pay with full benefits for the rest of the 18 weeks (APS 5019, system policy applying to all campuses).
components.mechanism_note: A dedicated parental leave; the university guarantees the 18-week period, paying half pay once accrued sick leave is exhausted (R1d: employer pays a stated fraction after balances run out; R1d names UCCS APS 5019 as its example).
components.faculty_group_note: Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty on nine-month appointments; APS 5019 Applies to: All Campuses. Other nine-month faculty receive the same benefit (II.C.1.b).
components.eligible_parent_wording: to provide care for the faculty member's child within twelve months of the birth, adoption, or foster care placement of the child
components.service_requirement: eligible for FMLA leave, or employed continuously for one year on a half-time or greater basis, whichever occurs earlier; part-time (50% or more) pro rata
components.dual_employee_rule: each may take; leaves may be taken simultaneously or staggered within 12 months of the birth, adoption or placement
components.duration_note: Eighteen weeks; accrued sick leave first, then half pay with full benefits for the remainder of the period. Counts as part of the FMLA twelve weeks (runs concurrently).
components.time_window: must be taken and completed within twelve months of the child's birth, adoption, or foster care placement
components.relief_note: A leave of absence; no relief stated (R9).

components.institution_label: Tenure Probationary Period For Tenure-Track Faculty
components.description: Parental leave under APS 5019 (including a negotiated alternative) does not count toward the tenure probationary period; it results in a one-year stop on the tenure clock, unless the faculty member elects (with dean and chancellor approval) to count it. At most two stops absent extraordinary circumstances.

components.duration_note: Stops must be taken in one-year increments.
components.use_limit_note: Absent extraordinary circumstances, a maximum of two "stops" on the tenure clock for parental leave

notes: Sources: 2018_00_link (APS 5019, the governing parental-leave policy, system-wide, Applies to: All Campuses, effective 2016-11-17, wayback 2018-02-04); 2018_01 (Regent Law Article 5; only 5.B.4(D) probationary period is relevant); 2018_02 (Regent Policy 11E: leave policies for staff and twelve-month faculty); 2018_03 (UCCS HR summary page; no provision, refers to department and handbook; captured 2016-06-22); 2018_04 (APS 1022, tenure review procedures; no leave or clock provision); 2018_05 (CU Faculty Handbook, compensation and leave); 2018_06 (CU Faculty Handbook, appointment and tenure principles; cross-references only).

Governing document: APS 5019 is a CU system policy that applies to all campuses; its Section IV lists campus parental-leave policies only for CU Boulder and CU Denver | Anschutz, none for UCCS, so the system policy sets UCCS figures (V3c: a system-wide policy applies to the campus). The 2018_00 version note says the copy is the policy in force on the reference date.
Reference date 2018-03-13. APS 5019 effective November 17, 2016; no provision with a later effective date found.

Birth parent chain: APS 5019 standard parental leave 18 weeks (accrued sick leave first, then half pay; c1) with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (c2) -> discretionary further unpaid leave or reduced load at reduced pay (c4 / c5 alternatives) consecutive_after c1, all within the 32-week leave limit. Alternative: a negotiated arrangement (c3) in_lieu_of c1. Tenure clock: one-year stop with the leave (c6), or elected stop without leave (c7).

Non-birth parent chain: the same as the birth parent (APS 5019 is role-neutral): c1 18 weeks with FMLA concurrent -> c4 / c5 consecutive_after c1 within 32 weeks; c3 in_lieu_of c1. No childbirth-specific or disability period exists for the birth parent beyond own sick leave (c9) and the unspecified disability coverage after six months of illness (c10).
Other nine-month faculty (non-tenure-track) receive the same 18-week benefit as tenured and tenure-track nine-month faculty (APS 5019 II.C.1.b); not coded separately because the terms are identical.

Groups not counted, recorded for completeness: university staff and twelve-month faculty (c11 six months parental leave from own balances or unpaid; c12 sick leave accrual with family care; c13 leave sharing; c14 general leave without pay). Twelve-month faculty are a group defined by appointment length that excludes the standard academic-year appointment (schema §2b).

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or adoption, checklist §1): bereavement leave, court and jury leave, military leave, job-related injury leave, political-candidate leave, furloughs (Regent Policy 11E; handbook). Sabbatical assignment (Regent Law 5.B.3(C); handbook IV) is a professional development assignment for tenured faculty after six years, not a leave for a birth. Differential workloads negotiable under Regent Law 5.B.3(A) are for career development and program needs, not a parental provision. Paid administrative leave (11E) is granted under an administrative policy statement that is not saved and whose purposes are not stated: not coded; noted here.

Cross-references cited but not saved: CU Boulder Parental Leave Policy for Tenured and Tenure-Track Faculty and CU Denver | Anschutz Medical Campus Parental Leave Policy (APS 5019 IV; other campuses, not UCCS); UCCS HR FMLA page (2018_03 'Also See: FMLA'); Employee Services Benefits Eligibility Matrix (2018_03); APS Leave Sharing for Officers, Exempt Professionals, and Faculty on Twelve-Month Appointments; the APS on paid administrative leave (11E); Faculty Handbook: Retirement, Insurance and Other Benefits (disability coverage); Regent Policy 5-F (political candidates); Regent Policy 11-H (military leave); Regent Policy 5-M; rules of the state personnel system (classified staff); APS Performance Ratings for Faculty and other APS listed in APS 1022 XIV and the handbooks. Laws of the Regents Article 5.B.4(D) is cited by APS 5019 for the tenure-clock stop; the saved Article 5 has no parental provision in 5.B.4(D).
Calendar: no document states term length or kind of term; calendar omitted (R8 default).
Leave limit: APS 5019 II.D.2 caps leave for 9-month faculty at 32 weeks in total, including the standard leave and FMLA leave; recorded in leave_limits on c1, c2, c4, c5.
